summary: Tiny 9 m kerb beside a school pool, steep, with stopping restrictions.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign nearby
Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: School buildings 11 m away and a pool complex; no dwellings within 28 m, but the school is busy by day.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb-to-fence on the west; stretch is only 9 m long.
drivers.traffic: School street; drop-off traffic on schooldays.
drivers.convention: 1/4P Parallel schooldays 8am-4pm and No Stopping Any Time signs; no overnight parking convention.

flags: No Stopping Any Time and 1/4P school-day signs
Two mapped car parks within 75 m might suit better
sun_shade: Overhanging trees shade the kerb, mostly from the west.
